title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The planned plant study compares seedlings under salt treatment with a water-only control. The treatment is 40 millimolar salt; the control contains no added salt. Height and leaf colour are observations, not direct measures of cellular damage. The proposal contains no completed experimental findings.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: There will be 30 seedlings in each condition, observed for 12 days. The primary comparison is change in height, with leaf colour as a secondary observation. Plants that fail to grow will remain in the analysis. The design does not test recovery after treatment removal.
